'''The Touched One''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] religious leader who lived during the during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the leader of the [[Debris Cult]], a group of fanatical scavengers who collected and revered the debris of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He was killed while piloting his own [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack craft]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] employed by the [[Yavin Four Labor and Mining Company|Yavin 4 Mining Company]].<ref name="SWG:KtDCL" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Touched One appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KtDCL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Touched One was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 29 November 04|Publish 11.3]]" update on [[November 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=291|text=Update Notes: - November 29, 2004 - Publish 11.3}}</ref>
